title: Spicy Salmon Rice Muffins
description: Sushi-style muffins: nori cups with a little rice and marinated salmon, baked crisp and topped with avocado and spicy mayo.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 272, rated 9.39/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @hungry.happens.

confidence.note: Amounts and method from the creator's caption. Not yet cooked. Rice vinegar, spring onion, seasonings and toppings are unquantified in the source.

nutrition.note: As stated by the creator; carbs, fat and fibre given as approximate.

items.prep: cut to fit the muffin tray cups

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Toss the salmon with the soy sauce ({{soy}}), honey ({{honey}}), rice vinegar, spring onion and seasonings.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Press the nori ({{nori}}) into the cups of a muffin tray. Add a spoonful of rice to each, about 30g ({{rice}} in total), then top generously with the salmon.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 17 minutes until the salmon is cooked through and the nori is crisp.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Top each with avocado and a light drizzle of spicy mayo. Serve warm.

notes.title: Salmon
notes.text: The source gives one fillet with no weight, for 6 muffins.
